notes: 面向脑部 MRI RAG：优先指南/共识、系统综述/Meta、高质量综述与典型临床研究；覆盖脑血管、脑肿瘤、神经内科、精神类疾病。

pubmed_queries.label: cerebrovascular_guideline
pubmed_queries.query: ((MRI[Title/Abstract] OR "magnetic resonance imaging"[Title/Abstract] OR neuroimaging[Title/Abstract]) AND (stroke[Title/Abstract] OR "cerebral infarction"[Title/Abstract] OR "intracerebral hemorrhage"[Title/Abstract] OR "subarachnoid hemorrhage"[Title/Abstract] OR "cerebral aneurysm"[Title/Abstract] OR "moyamoya"[Title/Abstract]) AND (Guideline[Publication Type] OR Practice Guideline[Publication Type] OR Consensus Development Conference[Publication Type] OR consensus[Title/Abstract] OR recommendation*[Title/Abstract])) AND (brain[Title/Abstract] OR cerebral[Title/Abstract] OR cerebrovascular[Title/Abstract])

pubmed_queries.label: brain_tumor_review
pubmed_queries.query: ((MRI[Title/Abstract] OR "magnetic resonance imaging"[Title/Abstract]) AND (glioma[Title/Abstract] OR glioblastoma[Title/Abstract] OR meningioma[Title/Abstract] OR "brain metastases"[Title/Abstract] OR "Brain Neoplasms"[MeSH]) AND (Review[Publication Type] OR Systematic Review[Publication Type] OR Meta-Analysis[Publication Type])) AND english[lang] AND ("2015"[Date - Publication] : "3000"[Date - Publication])

europepmc_queries.label: cerebrovascular_oa_guideline
europepmc_queries.query: (TITLE_ABS:(MRI OR "magnetic resonance imaging") AND TITLE_ABS:(stroke OR "ischemic stroke" OR "intracerebral hemorrhage" OR "subarachnoid hemorrhage" OR aneurysm) AND (PUB_TYPE:guideline OR TITLE_ABS:(guideline OR consensus OR recommendation))) AND OPEN_ACCESS:Y

europepmc_queries.label: brain_tumor_oa_review
europepmc_queries.query: (TITLE_ABS:(MRI OR "magnetic resonance imaging") AND TITLE_ABS:(glioma OR glioblastoma OR meningioma OR "brain metastases") AND (PUB_TYPE:review OR TITLE_ABS:("systematic review" OR "meta-analysis"))) AND OPEN_ACCESS:Y AND (FIRST_PDATE:[2015 TO 3000])
